title: Esrbespoke feature entry
description: One partner or location on a hairline: a 20px name at the left (with an optional block of address lines in tiny capitals at column 4) and, from column 7, a 4:3 photo, a short lead paragraph and label / text rows divided by hairlines. The left column can stay pinned while the right one scrolls; the photo fades in as it enters.
notes: a row with several items lists them one per line between hairlines; a row with one item reads as a paragraph
sticky keeps the name and address in view on desktop
the photo fade is CSS scroll-driven inside @supports, off under reduced motion
name: esrbespoke-feature

props.name: meta
props.description: address lines in tiny capitals at column 4 (optional)

props.name: media
props.description: the 4:3 photo (fills like object-fit: cover). Empty: a placeholder

props.name: lead
props.description: the lead paragraph under the photo

props.name: sticky
props.description: keep the left column in view while the right one scrolls (desktop)
